title: Sam Houston State University (SHSU)
summary: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) is a university in Huntsville. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with SHSU.

sections.heading: What SHSU is known for
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and large undergraduate enrollment of 17,743 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 90.26%, reflecting its accessible admissions process. SHSU is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business, which constitute about 18.22% of the student body, and health-related fields, accounting for roughly 10% of enrollment. These areas highlight the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in growing industries. As a public university, SHSU serves a broad community of learners with a variety of academic interests.

The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition, fees, and other expenses, amounts to $25,505.
